key_concepts: Breathing delivers oxygen to the body and removes carbon dioxide
Air moves through the nose/mouth, pharynx, larynx, trachea, bronchi, bronchioles, and alve
Cilia in the nasal cavity filter dust and small particles from inhaled air
The pharynx is a shared passageway for both food and air
Gas exchange between air and blood occurs in the alveoli of the lungs
The diaphragm and rib muscles move the chest cavity during breathing
The heart pumps blood through arteries, veins, and capillaries
Pulmonary circulation carries deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs and back
Systemic circulation carries oxygenated blood from the heart to the body and back
Blood flows from the vena cava to the right atrium, right ventricle, lungs, left atrium, l
Arteries have thicker walls than veins to handle pressure from the heart
